$sources: AISC 341-22 Seismic Provisions for Structural Steel Buildings: Sec A1, A3, D1, E1-E3, F1-F5 where revised; the other rules are the default pack's (BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 10.20, AISC 341-05 based), named as BNBC 2020's
source: AISC 341-22 (expected strengths, width-thickness limits of highly and moderately ductile members, the frame kinds' ductility); the rest from BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 10.20

hss.label: Hollow structural sections, ASTM A500 Grade C

hssOther.label: Hollow structural sections, ASTM A500 Grade B, A501

expected.note: AISC 341-22 Sec A3.2 (Ry, Rt by ASTM specification). A steel no row names takes the table's largest Ry and Rt: SAEngine practice

web.note: AISC 341-22 Table D1.1, webs of I-shapes in flexure or combined flexure and compression: Ca <= 0.114: 2.57 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)) (1 - 1.04 Ca); above: 0.88 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)) (2.68 - Ca) >= 1.57 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy))

widthThickness.note: AISC 341-22 Table D1.1 (highly ductile, λhd): coefficients of sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)), round HSS of E/(Ry Fy); Ca = Pu / (φc Py), φc 0.90. H-pile flanges and webs, flat bars and the relaxed ratio of SMF columns are the default pack's values

web.note: AISC 341-22 Table D1.1, webs of I-shapes: Ca <= 0.114: 3.96 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)) (1 - 3.04 Ca); above: 1.29 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)) (2.12 - Ca) >= 1.57 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy))

widthThicknessModerate.note: AISC 341-22 Table D1.1 (moderately ductile, λmd), coefficients of sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)); rectangular HSS walls 0.76 (SAEngine's reading, to verify); H-pile and flat bar values the default pack's

imf.note: AISC 341-22 Sec E2: beams and columns moderately ductile (Sec E2.5a); drift angle 0.02 rad (Sec E2.6b)

smf.note: AISC 341-22 Sec E3: beams and columns highly ductile (Sec E3.5a); drift angle 0.04 rad (Sec E3.6b); panel zone φ 1.00 (Sec E3.6e); the other values the default pack's
